capabilityUnbound: Choose a model for {capability} in Models & Model Policy first.
capabilityModel: Choose a model or snapshot that supports {capability}.
speechModel: Choose a supported Flash or Pro speech model or snapshot.
speechUnbound: Select a speech model in Models & Model Policy first.
voiceQuery: Voice pagination is invalid; use either an offset or a cursor within the supported bounds.
noKey: Save and enable credentials for {provider} under Model Providers before verifying or fetching models.
changed: Provider settings changed. Reload before continuing; changes from another window were not overwritten.
limit: At most 32 provider entries can be saved.
duplicateAdapter: Only one credential entry per provider is allowed (1 provider = 1 API key).
baseUrl: Base URL must start with http:// or https://, contain no whitespace, and be at most 512 characters.
policy: At most one policy per scene and up to 8 fallback models are allowed.
id: Provider IDs must be unique and contain 1–80 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
name: Enter a provider name of 1–80 characters.
key: A replacement key must not be empty, contain whitespace or exceed 4096 characters. Use Clear to remove a key.
bound: A scene binding or fallback requires an existing, enabled provider with credentials. Unbind it before deleting, disabling or clearing its key.
understandingUnbound: Choose a media understanding model in Models & Model Policy first.
understandingModel: This model or snapshot is not supported for media understanding.
imageUnbound: Choose a default image generation model in Models & Model Policy first.
imageModel: This model or snapshot is not integrated for image generation. Choose a supported image model.
authentication: The {provider} API key is invalid or expired. Update the credentials.
forbidden: {provider} denied access to the model catalog. Check account and API key permissions.
rateLimited: {provider} model discovery is rate limited. Retry manually later.
httpStatus: {provider} model discovery failed (HTTP {status}). No automatic retry was made.
network: Could not reach {provider} to read the model catalog. Check the network or base URL and retry.
timeout: {provider} model discovery timed out. No automatic retry was made.
invalidResponse: The {provider} model catalog response does not match the API contract.
tooLarge: The {provider} model catalog exceeds the read limit (1 MiB or 1000 models). No incomplete result was returned.
